main.description: Submit a 3D design request (text / image / CAD code) and start a LangGraph run that produces .glb mesh + .vox voxel artifacts on B2. Returns immediately with run_id; poll getRun for status. Per ADR-2605080700.

kind.description: Input modality. text = TRELLIS text→3D, image = ComfyUI 3D-Pack image→3D, cad = CadQuery Python exec→mesh.

prompt.description: Required when kind=text. Free-text description of the design (e.g., 'a small wooden cabin with a stone chimney').

imageUrl.description: Required when kind=image. Public URL or B2 presigned URL of the reference image.

cadCode.description: Required when kind=cad. CadQuery Python source code that builds a single Workplane / Compound and assigns it to a variable named `result`.

referenceArtifactId.description: Optional vertex_voxelforge_artifact.vertex_id of a prior artifact to use as conditioning input.

targetFormat.description: Output format(s) to materialize. 'both' produces .glb + .vox + voxel_grid.json + manifest.json.

targetVoxelDim.description: Target voxel grid edge length (cubic). 64 default. Higher = larger .vox file. Ignored when targetFormat=glb only.

palette.description: Optional explicit MagicaVoxel palette (≤256). When omitted, voxelizer auto-quantizes mesh colors with median-cut.

params.description: Free-form generator-specific parameters (e.g., { seed: 42, sampleSteps: 25 }). Passed through to TRELLIS / ComfyUI / CadQuery exec.

runId.description: LangGraph thread_id == run_id == sha256(designId). Use with getRun to poll.

status.description: Initial status. Almost always 'pending' or 'running' from this call.

estimatedSeconds.description: Heuristic ETA from generator routing. text/image≈90, cad≈15.

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: Required field missing or kind mismatch.

errors.name: BackendUnavailable
errors.description: RunPod pod or LangGraph Server unreachable.
